[SWS_CM_10380] Silently discarding
SOME/IP
event messages for unsubscribed
events
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_-
00009
⌈
If the event identified according to [SWS_CM_10325] does not have an active sub-
scription because the
Subscribe()
method (see [SWS_CM_00141]) of the specific
Field
class of the
ServiceProxy
class has not been called, or the
Unsubscribe()
method (see [SWS_CM_00151]) of the specific
Field
class of the
ServiceProxy
class has been called, or the
TTL
of the
SOME/IP
SubscribeEventgroup message
(see [SWS_CM_00205]) has expired, the received
SOME/IP
event message shall be
silently discarded (i.e., [SWS_CM_10326], [SWS_CM_10327], and [SWS_CM_10328]
shall
not
be performed. The received
SOME/IP
event message shall not be provided
to the
GetNewSamples()
API).
⌋
